newsList.title: Switch To In-Game Time For All Grand Prix Categories
newsList.body:
Hello everyone! Recently a poll was sent out in the MKDD Discord about whether to switch to the in-game timer for Grand Prix speedruns. If you're confused as to why, you can watch these videos for more information:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vA2eTxMx8Sc

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fhQyTi-

threadList.name: Why RTA instead of IGT for leaderboard positions

game.name: Mario Kart: Double Dash!!
game.rules:
All grand prix categories will use in-game timing.

- Please show the total time on the results screen at the end of the run, if possible.
- Avoid taking super long breaks.
- 50hz is banned.

categories.name: All Cup Tour
categories.rules:
RTA (Real Time) timing starts when pressing OK after selecting All Cup Tour and ends when crossing Rainbow Road's 3rd lap finish line.

Video proof is required for runs under **30m IGT**.
Runs have to be done in **150cc**, Mirror Mode will not count.
**Single player** only, 2 Player runs are not allowed.

categories.name: Mushroom Cup
categories.rules:
RTA (Real Time) timing starts when pressing OK after selecting Mushroom Cup and ends when crossing Dry Dry Desert's 3rd lap finish line.

Video proof is required for runs under **5m 45s IGT**.
Runs have to be done in **150cc**, Mirror Mode will not count.
**Single player** only, 2 Player runs are not allowed.

categories.name: Flower Cup
categories.rules:
RTA (Real Time) timing starts when pressing OK after selecting Flower Cup and ends when crossing Waluigi Stadium's 3rd lap finish line. Runs have to be done in 150cc, not Mirror Mode. All Shortcuts are allowed.

Video proof is required for runs under **6m 45s IGT**.
Runs have to be done in **150cc**, Mirror Mode will not count.
**Single player** only, 2 Player runs are not allowed.

categories.name: Star Cup
categories.rules:
RTA (Real Time) timing starts when pressing OK after selecting Star Cup and ends when crossing DK Mountain's 3rd lap finish line. Runs have to be done in 150cc, not Mirror Mode. All shortcuts are allowed.

Video proof is required for runs under **7m 15s IGT**.
Runs have to be done in **150cc**, Mirror Mode will not count.
**Single player** only, 2 Player runs are not allowed.
Only **60Hz** is allowed.

categories.name: Special Cup
categories.rules:
RTA (Real Time) timing starts when pressing OK after selecting Special Cup and ends when crossing Rainbow Road 3rd lap finish line. Runs have to be done in 150cc, not Mirror Mode. All shortcuts are allowed.

Video proof is required for runs under **10m IGT**.
Runs have to be done in **150cc**, Mirror Mode will not count.
**Single player** only, 2 Player runs are not allowed.
Only **60Hz** is allowed.

categories.name: All Tracks
categories.rules: Play all Time Trial tracks in order without restarting and add up all the In Game Times. Shortcuts are NOT allowed. Don't take long breaks between tracks. Video is required.
